dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Kaedehara Kazuha...

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Eh? That name sure sounds familiar... Oh, right, you mean that red-garbed guy from abroad!

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: He always sits by himself saying some real complicated stuff... But I've heard Uncle Liushi say that this guy can tell the weather as well as he can!

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: He even played me a tune once on a leaf. I never even knew that was possible!

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: So... I guess he's a good guy!

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Hey there, wanna join the Cygnus Fleet? If you join now, you'll be my second!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Cygnus Fleet?

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: It's my very own fleet! It's just me right now, but one day, it'll grow into something big!

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: My Ma and Pa were both sailors in the fleet, but they were returned to the sea during a voyage, so Captain Beidou took me in...

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: We have a saying here, it says "the new surpasses the old." Captain Beidou is the one who raised me, my fleet mustn't be an embarrassment to her!

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: I've always wanted to be a sailor myself, but the Captain's forbidden me to go out to sea, saying that it's too dangerous. So this time, I've secretly stowed aboard...

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: I got an earful from Uncle Juza, but I got to go out to sea, and that makes me a sailor now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you can tell me about the crew?

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Sure. I know everything about everyone!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you around.

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Seeya. Sign up soon if you want to join my fleet!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do tell me about the Chief Mate.

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Uncle Juza's real huge, and he looks scary, but he's a great guy!

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: ...Well, and his ears aren't all too good either.

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: He always mishears what we say. Says it's our fault we're always saying things only insects can hear.

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Funny thing is, though, that he only gets like this on land.

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: It's so noisy out at sea with the crashing waves and all, but somehow he hears us just fine out there. It's really weird...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about the crew...

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Well, Uncle Liushi loves to sing from the crow's nest. At first, no one knew who was doing that. Almost thought it was a ghost!

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Then there's Aunt Furong. Sometimes, when she's alone, she says the Captain's name over and over, and her face is all red...

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, and there's Aunt Yinxing, who really loves animals. You can't take pets on board, so she raises a few fish in her cups...

dialogues.speaker: Little Yue
dialogues.text: ...So there was this one time when Uncle Sea Drake got dead drunk, and he drank her fish with his grog. Till today, she has no clue how they went missing...
